decisions.decision: Mr. Lockwood requested the Sewer Commission be invited to the October 21st Board meeting for any input.
decisions.quote: mr. lockwood requested the sewer commission be invited to the october 21st board meeting for any input they may wish to provide.

decisions.decision: Mylar for the ANR to be obtained from Whitman & Bingham Associates and kept in the Planning Office for Board signatures.
decisions.quote: mylar will be obtained from whitman & bingham associates and be available in the planning office for board signatures.

decisions.decision: Board will hold a workshop on Goals; per the meeting-end correction, the workshop is the August 26, 2013 meeting at 5:30 PM at Town Hall.
decisions.quote: (it was noted at the meeting conclusion that it will be the meeting of august 26, 2013 which will begin at 5:30 pm at town hall.)

decisions.decision: Ms. Benson to move ahead with the public document access process; files to be set read-only for public access without username/password.
decisions.quote: ms. benson to move ahead with process.

decisions.decision: 300 W. Holman & 300 Holman St item to be placed on the September 23rd agenda for discussion.
decisions.quote: item will be placed on the september 23rd agenda for discussion.

decisions.decision: MRPC response to Board questions distributed; to be discussed at the next Board meeting.
decisions.quote: distributed additional response to their questions and discuss at the next board meeting.

decisions.decision: Lazaro driveway permit on a Scenic Road: a public hearing must be held; additional information requested from applicant before hearing can be scheduled.
decisions.quote: as property is located on a scenic road, a public hearing must be held.

decisions.decision: Continue the Citizen Survey as presented, adding a definition of the CPA and a question on medical marijuana.
decisions.quote: it was recommended to continue with the survey as presented to include a definition of the cpa and a question on medical marijuana as noted below.

decisions.decision: Emerald Place developer to add a crosswalk from the development to the beach area; developer to appear before the Board on September 23rd to discuss lease-to-own.
decisions.quote: developer will put an additional crosswalk in place, which will be from the development to the beach area.

decisions.decision: Whalom Road LLC/Lunenburg Village: Board input on development name; Ms. Bilotta-Simeone to research with Town Counsel.
decisions.quote: ms. bilotta-simeone to research with town counsel.

decisions.decision: Ms. Benson and Mr. Lockwood to coordinate on a draft letter to the Select Board regarding Town land acquisition.
decisions.quote: ms. benson and mr. lockwood will coordinate on a draft letter to the select board.

decisions.decision: Mr. Allison's town center documents to be sent to MRPC.
decisions.quote: documents will be sent to mrpc

decisions.decision: Ms. Benson to pass the Lancaster Avenue speed-limit sign concern to the DPW Director.
decisions.quote: ms. benson will pass comment on to dpw director.

decisions.decision: Ms. Benson to confer with Town Counsel for clarity in Section 5.6 of the Zoning Bylaw (25-acre provision).
decisions.quote: ms. benson to confer with town counsel for clarity in section 5.6.

decisions.decision: Ms. Benson to provide the Board with a reviewing-engineer checklist, including easement review, for possible additions and/or changes.
decisions.quote: ms. benson to provide the board with the checklist for any possible additions and/or changes.

decisions.decision: Ms. Benson will confer with the Town Manager regarding funding for the two Planning Director items needing update.
decisions.quote: will confer with the town manager regarding funding.

budget_items.topic: Public document access - PCs for Board members
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Select Board PCs were previously considered and found not to be a cost benefit over paper copies; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: it was determined at that time there was not a cost benefit over paper copies for the select board.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion that a new extension fee must be justifiable and cover administrative staff time; Mr. Allison felt it should be excessive; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: if a fee is put in place, ms. bilotta-simeone opined that the amount must be justifiable, i.e., it must cover the administrative staff costs of time involved to process same.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State student reimbursement criteria checked; the Town does not qualify this year; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the town assessor worked with the state to determine if the development meets state criteria for student reimbursement.
